:::{#exr-scalar-mult-practice}
#### Multiplying a matrix by a negative factor

A [scalar multiple](#def-scalar-mult) rescales every entry of a [matrix](#def-matrix) by the same factor,
as when a table of measurements changes units.
A negative factor flips the sign of every entry,
and a factor between $-1$ and $1$ shrinks every entry toward $0$.
Let

$$
\matr{C} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & -2 \\ 0 & 6 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Compute $-\frac{1}{2} \matr{C}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Multiply each entry by $-\frac{1}{2}$,
as in @exm-scalar-mult.

:::
